unit.why: Opening of the Seer of Lublin chapter: mostly praise and descriptions of his habits from testimonies, with one anecdote: in the year he died he wrote his monthly forecasts only up to Av, the month of his death.
unit.boundary_note: chapter introduction; the following division (ב) begins the separate accounts of his deeds

stories.start_quote: מחו׳ הרב הגאון הקדוש האלקי רשכב"ה
stories.summary_en: Testimonies praise the Seer of Lublin: he never lifted his eyes without a divine unification, he read people's deeds through their name-notes, and each day of early Nisan he wrote what the matching month would bring; in the year of his death he wrote only up to Av, the month he died.

tags.why: praise of the tzaddik's holy levels
